verses.pali: “Ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a mendicant is grounded in one thing the five faculties become developed, well developed.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cittaṁ rakkhati āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant looks after their mind when it comes to defilements and things accompanied by defilements.

verses.pali: Tassa cittaṁ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddhindriyampi bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: As they do so the faculties of faith,

verses.pali: Evampi kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitānī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how when a mendicant is grounded in one thing the five faculties become developed, well developed.”
